title: Design Engineer
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an outstanding engineer with a real passion for design.

Nubank's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer - which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nubank scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

NuBrain - the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture - how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

A design quality measurement platform. The function knows what good looks like and has the parameters written down; scoring a flow against them is currently a manual exercise in Figma. The goal is an index - a real number for the quality of a given experience - produced by a system, not a spreadsheet.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

Deciding the shape of the answer. Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform - that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Architect and build the systems design at Nubank runs on - increasingly agentic ones.

- Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable.

- Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function.

- Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

- Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you.

- Be the technical voice in a design organization - make trade-offs legible to people who don't read code.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

An outstanding, deeply experienced engineer. This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on.

A track record architecting UX systems. Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale - design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

A love for design that shows up in your work. Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them.

Agentic systems that help design scale. Ideally you've built them - agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do mo

title: Senior Software Engineer, SLAM/VIO
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

We are building the perception stack that enables robust three/six degrees of freedom tracking, localization, and mapping in complex real-world environments. This role focuses on fusing data from cameras and inertial sensors to power SLAM / Visual-Inertial Odometry pipelines. We need an experienced perception software engineer who can create algorithms and systems that run in real time, handle uncertainty gracefully, and provide the foundation for advanced spatial intelligence on edge devices.

 

Responsibilities

- Develop and optimize sensor fusion algorithms combining IMU and camera data for SLAM and VIO (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping & Visual Inertial Odometry)

- Implement state of the art structure-from-motion techniques using different sensor modalities to generate consistent 3D reconstructions

- Evaluate algos against public benchmarks and real-world datasets

- Integrate outputs into higher-level autonomy or collaborative mapping systems (i.e. shared mapping systems)

- Collaborate with HW, robotics and platform teams to ensure end-to-end performance

- Define metrics, testing frameworks and deployment strategies for production-ready perception systems

Requirements

- BS with 10+ years of academic or industry experience in inertial sensing, computer vision, robotics or related fields with shipped or published work (or MS with 8+ yrs of the above)

- Shipped SLAM/VIO features to product

- Strong background in linear algebra, 3D geometry, VIO (probabilistic filtering and/or factor-graph optimization), and visual mapping (incremental mapping, submaps, loop closure)

- Proficient in C++/Python with experience in real-time optimization

- Proficient in using and debugging geometric optimization frameworks (e.g. Ceres, GTSAM, g2o)

- Knowledge of sensor modelling, calibration and noise characteristics

- Experience with real-time processing pipelines on embedded or edge hardware

- Preferred track record of applied research in robotics or AR/VR

 

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.

Rivet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Certain roles may require U.S. Person status, security clearance eligibility, or other requirements imposed by law or government contract.

title: Senior Tax Analyst (LatAm Only)

description:
At R2 , we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.
R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, and J.P. Morgan. We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling our operations across multiple markets.
As a Senior Tax Analyst (IC3) you will play a key role in improving tax compliance and efficiency across R2 ’s operations in Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Brazil, Cayman and the USA, while supporting the company’s growth into new products and markets.
What you’ll work on

• Review monthly tax compliance obligations in Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Chile and Mexico (VAT, income tax and withholding taxes, among others), working with our BPO providers to adjust procedures and improve timing, accuracy and documentation.

• Own the regional tax obligations calendar and tax payments control, ensuring deliverables are on time and that tax files and supporting documents are organized by tax type and country.

• Monitor the tax authorities’ electronic mailboxes in all countries, analyzing notices and information requests and coordinating timely responses with the Tax Manager and external advisors.

• Configure and optimize the tax setup of our ERP as a whole, including electronic invoicing, withholding tax documents and other tax supporting documents, becoming the owner of these processes from a tax perspective.

• Review the group’s transfer pricing policies and calculations, ensuring adherence to the arm’s length principle and that documentation and filings are complete and timely.

description:
Bennett Aerospace , Inc., a subsidiary of Three Saints Bay, LLC, is seeking an Army National Guard Recruiting and Retention Subject Matter Expert to support the development of a competitive federal proposal.
This is a temporary, part-time consulting opportunity focused on helping our proposal team understand and respond to an Army National Guard requirement involving the Guard Strength Enhancement Program, Reserve Component transition counseling, recruiting and accession support, and related program management and help desk functions.
The selected SME will provide operational insight into how the ARNG identifies, counsels, processes, and tracks Soldiers transitioning from the Active Component, Army Reserve, and Individual Ready Reserve into ARNG units. The SME will help ensure our proposed technical, staffing, management, and quality-control approaches reflect how this work is performed in the field.
Responsibilities

• Review the Performance Work Statement and related solicitation documents to identify operational requirements, risks, dependencies, and performance expectations.

• Advise the proposal team on ARNG recruiting, retention, accession, and Reserve Component transition processes.

• Explain the roles and working relationships among ARNG G1 organizations, Reserve Component Career Counselors, Transition Counselors, Recruiting and Retention Battalions, Interstate Transfer and In-Service Recruiting personnel, and gaining units.

• Help develop an operational approach for the Guard Strength Enhancement Program and Active Component-to-Reserve Component transitions.

• Provide insight into counseling Soldiers on ARNG and USAR opportunities, eligibility, benefits, incentives, entitlements, vacancies, assignments, and continued-service options.

• Advise on the preparation, review, quality control, approval, and tracking of accession and transition packets.

• Provide practical knowledge of relevant systems, including RETAIN, IPPS-A, iPERMS, MEDPROS, DPRO, AUVS, and related Army personnel systems.

• Help identify appropriate labor categories, qualifications, staffing levels, workload assumptions, and organizational relationships.

• Review proposed workflows for transition counseling, help desk support, system-access requests, production reporting, Soldier tracking, and issue resolution.

• Assist in developing realistic performance metrics and quality-control methods for counseling, packet processing, accessions, customer support, reporting, and vacancy management.

• Review proposal content for operational accuracy, completeness, and alignment with ARNG and Department of the Army policies and practices.

• Participate in proposal strategy sessions, solution-development meetings, and draft reviews as needed.

Required Qualifications:

• Former Army or Army National Guard service with substantial experience in recruiting, retention, career counseling, military personnel, strength management, or Reserve Component transition operations.

• Direct knowledge of ARNG recruiting and retention processes and the accession of Soldiers into Army National Guard units.

• Experience supporting Soldiers transitioning from the Active Component, Army Reserve, or Individual Ready Reserve.

• Working knowledge of Army accession, reenlistment, assignment, vacancy, and personnel-readiness processes.

• Familiarity with applicable Army and National Guard policies, including AR 601-280 and related accession and transition guidance.

• Ability to translate operational experience into clear recommendations for proposal writers and business-development personnel.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Availability to support a time-sensitive proposal effort on a part-time consulting basis.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior service in an Army 79-series MOS, particularly 79T, 79S, 79V, or 79R.

• Completion of the Reserve Component Transition NCO course or award of ASI 4R.

• Experience serving as a Reserve Component Career Counselor

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking an experienced Software Quality Assurance Engineer to independently execute and take expanded ownership of quality assurance and test automation activities on the BASIS program. Operating with minimal supervision, the QA Engineer carries direct responsibility for automated test design and delivery, test documentation ownership, defect lifecycle management, and security testing integration - all in support of the program's automation-first QA mandate. All quality assurance activities must be automated.
The selected candidate will independently manage test automation deliverables across Agile sprint cycles, contribute to QA strategy discussions, support junior engineers, and interface with developers and Government stakeholders on quality metrics and release readiness across the deployment pipeline.
This is a 100% remote role.
Test Automation Development & Strategy

• Independently design, develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end functional testing across the application portfolio.

• Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and fully integrated into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline with minimal oversight.

• Drive and apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology - authoring test cases prior to code development and collaborating closely with software engineers to align test coverage with functional requirements.

• Lead the Test Automation State Assessment for assigned application areas; produce assessment reports with automation completion estimates.

• Own the automation of adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedules to systematically expand regression coverage across the portfolio.

• Evaluate automation approaches and recommend improvements to test architecture, reusability, and pipeline integration within the Government-provided automation framework.

• Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior QA engineers on automation best practices, test script development, and tool usage.

Test Planning & Documentation

• Develop and own Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, ensuring full traceability and complete testing coverage of all functional and non-functional requirements.

• Document all test activities, execution results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System with accuracy and completeness.

• Independently prepare Testing Reports, Release Notes (Draft and Final), and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements.

Quality Assurance & Defect Management

• Enforce and monitor hard contractual quality thresholds with zero defects released to production.

• Lead defect triage and root cause analysis in JIRA; manage the full escalation workflow to product teams with complete documentation and submit JIRA tickets prior to all escalations.

• Own and submit weekly defect escalation reports to customers and the Government Product Owner.

Section 508 / Accessibility Testing

• Lead Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring continuous integration of accessibility compliance into the QA process.

• Own preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and conformance level documentation for all applicable deliverables.

• Report Section 508 compliance testing status and metrics.

Performance & Environment Testing

• Lead stress and load testing activities in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment; prepare and submit detailed test schedules for Government approval and execute per approved schedule.

• Coordinate and support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with technical and operations teams.

• Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application prior to prod

title: PR & Communications Manager - Germany

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview

Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. Following its recent partnership with Aleph Alpha, the company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine.

In this cross functional role, you will stand up our PR and Communications function in the German market. You'll partner with the Global Corporate Communications team and EMEA Communications team to create a regional communication plan that fuels our growth among governments and enterprises in the most highly-regulated industries across DACH. You’ll nurture how we talk to customers, partners, and employees, ensuring that the corporate message resonates culturally for the German market and its audiences.

This is a rare opportunity to build a comprehensive German PR function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who likes to take big swings - and have fun doing it - where no job is too big or too small.

Key Responsibilities

As the Communications Manager for Germany, you will:

- Own and drive Cohere’s German communications strategy, aligning corporate priorities, business objectives, product innovation, executive visibility and technical differentiation to strengthen the company’s reputation in Germany

- Translate Cohere’s innovations and customer success stories into compelling, locally relevant narratives for German-speaking audiences

- Lead proactive media engagement and newsjacking opportunities in close collaboration with EMEA Communications and EMEA Government Affairs, capitalising on relevant industry and policy developments to amplify Cohere’s voice

- Elevate the profile and influence of Cohere’s German leadership and spokespeople by partnering with Executive Communications to develop strategic messaging, thought leadership, media opportunities and executive visibility programmes, including for the German Country Manager.

- Strengthen Cohere’s reputation through customer- and partner-led storytelling, working closely with Partner Marketing to showcase German customer outcomes, deepen strategic relationships and amplify the impact of Cohere’s ecosystem in the local market.

- Lead and coordinate German crisis and issues communications, partnering with Corporate Communications and relevant local and regional teams to anticipate reputational risks, develop response strategies and ensure clear and timely communications.

title: Threat Detection & Response Engineer, AI-Era Detection & Response
description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro , empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
AI Fearlessly.
About the Team

Our Security Research & Development group sits at the frontier of AI-era cyber defense. We study how attackers are beginning to weaponize artificial intelligence, how AI is reshaping detection and response, and what durable capabilities defenders will need over the next several years. We are not a day-to-day operations team. Our charter is to research, prototype, and design the core capabilities that will anchor our platform and our customers' defenses for the next generation.
The Role

We are seeking a Threat Detection & Response Engineer to help research AI-era threats and defensive technologies and to build the detection-and-response capabilities that strengthen our platform. This is a mid-level individual-contributor role that combines threat research with hands-on engineering.
Working closely with senior architects and researchers, you will investigate emerging threats, build and test prototypes, and help turn promising research into production-ready capabilities. You will collaborate across threat intelligence, detection engineering, and AI/ML teams to translate findings into practical detection and response improvements. This role is an excellent path for an engineer looking to grow toward senior and principal-level threat architecture.
Key Responsibilities

• Threat & technology research. Investigate emerging AI-era threats - including AI-enabled attacks and threats to AI systems (e.g., prompt injection, model misuse) - and summarize findings for the team.

• Detection engineering. Build, test, and refine detection-and-response capabilities that integrate with existing security tooling and analyst workflows, under the guidance of senior architects.

• Prototyping & experimentation. Develop and evaluate prototypes to test the feasibility of new defensive approaches; help document them into clear specifications.

• Collaboration. Partner with detection engineering, data science, and platform teams to move prototypes toward production-ready capabilities.

• Communication. Communicate research findings and technical work clearly to teammates and stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years in cybersecurity, software engineering, or a related technical field, with exposure to threat detection and response.

• Experience building or contributing to technical systems that reached production.

• Familiarity with security tooling and operational workflows, and an interest in how they integrate.

• Basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their application to threat detection, and awareness of frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

• Daily dial volume

• Connect/conversation rates

• Conversations-to-meeting conversion

• Meeting show rates

• Weekly meetings booked

Our client, an early-stage women's health venture, has a defined concept and written description for a sensor-based wearable and is seeking experienced technical guidance before moving into hardware development. The founders - whose team includes a midwife - will continue to drive the research and day-to-day development themselves; they need an advisor who can stress-test the concept, flag feasibility gaps, and help translate a promising idea into a realistic, buildable hardware specification. Our client is an early-stage, founder-funded venture building products for women's health, working on several in parallel. A pessoa atua na base de Application Security do time, sendo dona do ciclo de vulnerabilidades junto às squads, e aprofunda em Adversarial Security, conduzindo pentests internos de aplicações, APIs e mobile com foco em lógica de negócio e risco financeiro. Trabalha em um time AI-first, usando automação e agentes de IA para escalar segurança para toda a engenharia.
RESPONSABILIDADES
Ser dono do ciclo de vida das vulnerabilidades de aplicação: triagem, priorização por risco de negócio (perda financeira e exposição de dados de clientes), negociação de prazos com as squads, acompanhamento e validação da correção.
Conduzir threat modeling e design review de features críticas, como Pix, crédito, cartões e onboarding, antes do desenvolvimento.
Fazer code review de segurança e evoluir os controles de SAST e SCA no pipeline, aumentando a cobertura e reduzindo falsos positivos.
Planejar e executar pentests de aplicações web, APIs e mobile, com foco em lógica de negócio, autenticação e autorização, transformando achados em correção e em testes de regressão.
Definir o escopo técnico dos pentests externos e do ciclo anual de PCI DSS, e triar os achados que chegam de fora (bug bounty, consultorias e reportes externos), validando explorabilidade, severidade real e dono antes de levar às squads.
Apoiar o programa de Security Champions, orientando as squads e elevando a maturidade de desenvolvimento seguro.
Usar e construir automações e agentes de IA para escalar code review, triagem e testes de segurança. Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar os analistas plenos do time.
Requirements
Experiência sólida em Application Security em empresa de produto, incluindo gestão de vulnerabilidades de ponta a ponta com times de desenvolvimento e priorização por risco de negócio.
Experiência em pentest de aplicações web e APIs (REST/GraphQL), incluindo lógica de negócio, autenticação e autorização (IDOR/BOLA).
Code review de segurança em pelo menos uma linguagem de backend (Java, Kotlin, Go, Python ou Node.js). Experiência com threat modeling e com ferramentas de SAST e SCA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.
Desenvolvimento de scripts e automações em Python ou Go. Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação, advisories e pesquisas.
Formação em tecnologia e áreas afins, ou experiência equivalente.
Diferencial: pentest mobile Android e iOS (Frida, objection, Burp Suite).
Diferencial: segurança de LLMs, agentes e MCPs, ou uso de agentes de IA em fluxos de segurança.
Diferencial: vivência em ambiente financeiro regulado (PCI DSS, LGPD, BACEN).
Diferencial: certificações como OSWE, BSCP, OSCP ou equivalentes.
COMPETÊNCIAS
Ownership: acompanha a vulnerabilidade até a correção, sem parar no relatório. Julgamento de risco: separa o que é explorável e relevante para o negócio do ruído, sem inflar severidade.
Influência com engenharia: convence squads com evidência e negocia prazo e mitigação quando a correção imediata não é possível.
Comunicação em dois níveis: explica impacto para a liderança e o passo de correção para quem desenvolve.

title: Network Operator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.

ROLE SCOPE

- Serve as the on-site Tier 3 escalation point for network and structured-cabling incidents across the site's AI infrastructure.

- Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve physical-layer faults, validate repairs, and drive rapid resolution of issues hitting customer workloads.

- Act as the escalation path for Tier 1 and 2 technicians, and partner with Network Operations on deeper investigations.

- Own structured cabling and fiber infrastructure, and interpret device-level diagnostics well enough to confirm a physical repair restored connectivity.

- Escalate out-of-scope issues to Network Operations with clear documentation, and take ownership through resolution as the sole on-site network and ICT resource.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- You've been the on-site network or cable-plant specialist in a data center, owning physical-layer troubleshooting end to end.

- You know structured cabling and fiber deeply (testing, termination, fault isolation) and you read device diagnostics well enough to validate repairs.

- You have enough network fundamentals (TCP/IP, switching, optics) to bridge cabling and the network stack.

- You operate as the sole escalation resource on-site and take incidents through to resolution.

- You document rigorously, so Network Operations can pick up cleanly when an issue exceeds on-site scope.

- Bonus: H

We are looking for engineers who have personally owned meaningful technical work-such as taking a hardware system into production, validating a model against test data, developing a rigorous verification approach, or diagnosing a difficult failure. • Demonstrated ownership of a substantial engineering problem-for example, a product or subsystem that reached production, a model validated against physical testing, a test system you developed, or a difficult failure you diagnosed.

• Experience working with Coding Agents is a must

Process

title: Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Liechtenstein
description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Liechtenstein
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Liechtenstein. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.
The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.
What you will work on
The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.
What you bring
Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.
Useful but not essential:
A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Platform Software Engineer for our Systems Software Team. You will be working as part of a dynamic team and will be responsible for designing, developing, and testing system software functionality for Pure’s upcoming platforms. The work spans the gamut of Systems software and you will have the opportunity to work in a wide range of areas and features ranging from Platform drivers to networking and storage layers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Plan and influence the lifecycle of new Hardware Platforms.  Work on problems ranging from design, bring up, to deployment, upgrades and fleet level reliability.

• Participate in the full lifecycle of new hardware platforms from early bring up through manufacturing release.  Work closely with peer teams to debug complex HW/FW of new server hardware, including CPUs, chipsets, and peripheral components. Debug complex HW/FW issues across x86, PCIe, NVMe, and networking using lab tools (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG) and kernel/driver traces.

• Design, implement and improve remote server management capabilities (e.g., using standards like Redfish) and enhance Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) features.

• Design, write and maintain software components in C/C++, Python, Golang and RUST.

• Collaborate with vendors on requirements specification and follow through to system delivery.

• Work closely with hardware engineers, system architects, and operating system developers to define specifications, review designs, and ensure seamless hardware-software integration. 

REQUIREMENTS:

• Preferred B.S or M.S in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Proficiency in C/C++ (object oriented design and C++ 11 and onwards) and strong Python skills for build/test automation and lab tooling. Experience in Golang and RUST is desirable.

• Strong interest in CPU Architecture and Data Centre Hardware. Desire to dive deep in solving problems at the intersection of hardware and software.

• Experience leading teams and projects both within the organization and across cross-functional groups.

• Hands on experience with hardware platforms, including design/requirements feedback, bring-up, system-level debugging, customer delivery, and support.

• Experience with most or all of: CPU architectures, BMC, BIOS, PCI-e, I2C (and SMBUS, PMBUS variants).

• Solid Linux skills (kernel logs, drivers, bootloaders) and ability to root‑cause across HW/FW/OS boundaries.

• Good verbal communication & collaboration skills.

NICE TO HAVE REQUIREMENTS

• Prior experience shipping /supporting enterprise class x86 based appliances

• Prior experience with BMC firmware, OpenBMC or equivalent, and management protocols such as Redfish/IPMI.

• Prior experience with BIOS/UEFI development and/or debugging

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Commercial
description:
ABOUT TEMPORAL

Distributed systems fail in ordinary ways: services crash, networks drop, and long-running processes get cut off halfway. Engineers end up writing retries, state tracking, and recovery code instead of building their product. Temporal removes that work. With Durable Execution, code runs to completion through any failure, so teams ship reliable applications faster.
The need is growing fastest in AI, where agents run for hours or days and depend on services that fail. That’s why OpenAI, Cursor, Lovable, Stripe, and Snap run critical workloads on Temporal, and why we raised a Series E at a $12.55B valuation. Our founders, Maxim Fateev and Samar Abbas, built AWS Simple Workflow Service and the foundation of Azure Durable Functions, then co-created Cadence at Uber before starting Temporal.

SUMMARY

We’re hiring two Senior Solutions Architects for our Commercial team: one focused on new logo acquisition, one on growth and expansion within our existing customer base.

- New Logo. You thrive in the early stages of a sales cycle. You’re energized by discovery, whiteboarding with skeptical engineers, and earning technical trust in competitive deals. You turn “we’ve never heard of Temporal” into “we’re building on Temporal.”

- Growth and Expansion. You’re at your best once a customer is live. You understand their architecture, spot where Temporal can go deeper, and partner with the account team to unlock new workloads, teams, and use cases. You turn one workflow into an enterprise-wide standard.

In either role, you’re the technical lead on your deals, partnering with Account Executives and working with developers, architects, and engineering leaders at fast-moving companies. Temporal Cloud is consumption-based, so we succeed when customers grow their adoption of Temporal Cloud, and your primary goal is driving that consumption. This is a sales role for technical people: you love solving customer problems, and you want the deal to close.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Partner with AEs to qualify opportunities and run technical evaluations, from discovery through proof of concept to a decision

- Lead technical conversations with developers, architects, and engineering leaders to understand their systems, constraints, and goals

- Find and win new workloads, teams, and use cases inside existing customers

- Build focused demos and proofs of concept, including orchestration of AI and agent workloads

- Help customer engineering teams adopt and expand their Temporal usage

- Build tools, automations, and reference implementations that elevate the team around you

title: Senior Software Engineer - ClickHouse Private (Remote)
description:
About the role

ClickHouse Private brings ClickHouse Cloud capabilities to Kubernetes environments controlled by customers, from managed Kubernetes in their AWS, GCP or Azure accounts to clusters running on other infrastructure they provide. Today, much of our work focuses on adapting Cloud technology so it can be deployed, upgraded and supported in these environments, including regulated and disconnected deployments.

Our plans also include building software and platform capabilities specifically for ClickHouse Private, such as tools and interfaces for managing ClickHouse clusters. We will reuse Cloud components where they fit and build our own implementations where customer-controlled environments require a different approach. Depending on the deployment model, these components may run in ClickHouse-managed infrastructure, in customer environments, or across both.

You will join a small product engineering team with broad ownership and real architectural influence. The role combines hands-on software development with deep Kubernetes and infrastructure knowledge, from designing production services to making them reliable to deploy, upgrade and support.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

- Design and build backend services and platform capabilities for ClickHouse Private, combining reusable Cloud components with purpose-built implementations.

- Adapt and integrate existing ClickHouse Cloud components for Kubernetes-based deployments in customer-controlled cloud and self-hosted environments.

- Build and maintain what customers actually install: Helm charts, Kubernetes operators, and deployment tooling.

- Make installation and upgrades boring: build preflight validation, deterministic tooling, health diagnostics, and safe recovery paths.

- Build release automation: assemble tested sets of components, define supported upgrade paths, and make failures diagnosable.

- Adapt deployments for regulated and network-restricted environments.

- Work alongside support engineers on customer deployments and troubleshoot problems in customer-controlled environments.

- Turn recurring customer requirements and deployment constraints into reusable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.

- Write the documentation and runbooks customers and our support teams rely on.

ABOUT YOU

- You have 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software, including infrastructure or platform systems.

- You have strong Kubernetes experience, managed or self-hosted. You are comfortable with Helm and understand how operators and controllers work.

- You write and maintain production software. Go experience is preferred; strong experience in another language is welcome if you are ready to work in Go.

- You have experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or an equivalent on-premises cloud platform, plus solid Linux and networking fundamentals.

- You can debug unfamiliar distributed systems and infrastructure, including across boundaries you do not control.

- You communicate clearly in design docs, pull requests, and conversations with support and customer engineers.

- You make pragmatic trade-offs, deliver incrementally, and take ownership from design through a supportable release.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience shipping software into environments you do not operate: customer sites, on-premises installations, self-hosted products, Kubernetes operators, CSI drivers, or object storage integrations.

- Experience with ClickHouse, or with other databases.

- Experience with regulated, security-sensitive, or air-gapped environments, including public-sector deployments.

- Experience designing and running performance benchmarks for infrastructure or distributed systems.

- Security-related experience: vulnerability management, image hardening, secrets management, and internal PKI.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions

About the Team
AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era.

Rapid7 's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. • Lead design reviews and resolve the hardest technical trade-offs

• Stay hands-on: prototype and build critical model, training and inference code yourself

• 12+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or agentic AI systems. Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This internship will be approximately 12 weeks and includes both project-based and experiential learning. title: Customer Success Manager, Europe (Spanish Speaking)
description:
About SuiteOp

Hospitality is one of the most human businesses in the world, and one of the hardest to run. Behind every great stay is someone who answered a guest at midnight, a cleaner who turned a home in two hours, and an operator holding it all together with spreadsheets and group chats.

We started SuiteOp because we've been those operators. Our founders ran rentals before they built software for them, and that's still how we build: we sit with operators, watch where their day breaks, and fix it.

Today more than 30,000 units run on SuiteOp , across short-term rentals and boutique hotels. With SuiteOp V2, AI agents take on the repetitive work, from guest messages to turnovers, so operators and their teams can get back to the part that matters: hospitality.

We're a small team (seed stage, $3M+ raised), headquartered in New York with customers around the world. We care deeply about the craft. We sweat the details operators feel every day, we ship fast, and we use AI in everything we do because it lets a small team build something great.

About the role

SuiteOp is growing fast in Europe, and we need someone on the ground to make sure every European operator who signs with us gets live and loves it. Onboarding is the heart of this role. You'll guide new customers from signed contract to launch day and beyond. Our onboarding is heavily powered by AI: agents handle much of the setup, and you'll be the person who makes sure every customer feels supported, confident, and ready. Then you'll help us make it even faster for the next one.

You bring energy to every conversation and keep momentum going. You guide customers confidently through each step, secure clear next steps, and get them live.

You'll work closely with our Customer Success & Solutions Lead in New York, and what you learn from European operators will shape what we build next.

What you'll do

• Own onboarding from signed contract to go-live for new customers across Spain and the rest of Europe

• Lead onboarding calls in Spanish and English: kickoff, configuration, training, and launch

• Become a SuiteOp V2 expert and guide customers through best practices

• Use AI to build onboarding plans, checklists, and timelines, so every account keeps moving without manual overhead

• Turn customer conversations into clear, actionable feedback for Engineering, using Claude and our internal tools to spot patterns across accounts

• Build onboarding guides, videos, and templates in Spanish and English that help customers succeed on their own

• Watch account health and remove blockers before customers feel them

AI is how we work

Our team runs on Claude. It isn't a trend for us. It means less time on busywork and more time with customers. We're looking for someone who already works this way and loves it.

• You build AI workflows and agents that make onboarding faster and more personal, and you can't wait to show us one you're proud of

• You reach for AI first to draft, summarize, and organize, so your time goes to the customer

• You don't wait for structure: you build it, then automate it

• Bonus: you've built with Claude Code, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

What you bring

• You love helping people, and you stay calm and kind on a customer's busiest day

• You can make a complex product feel simple

• Native or fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken

• 2 to 5 years in SaaS onboarding, customer success, account management, consulting, or a similar role

• Experience running customer meetings and guiding customers through technical setup

• Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Intercom, Notion, or Zendesk

• Organized and detail-oriented, comfortable managing several customers at once

• Bonus: Portuguese, French, Italian, or German

• Bonus: experience in hospitality, property management, or a startup
